title: Yet Done
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：yet　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 yet 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Yet, in 1968 the clerk finished the stamp at the counter, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the May rains the clerk had ② yet finished the stamp, and nobody had asked a single question. The clerk had come to the office two months earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The file for May 1962 puts it plainer. The stamp was ③ yet ready, and the applicant who kept it had ④ yet signed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done yet in those days. The applicant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else. He finished the stamp ⑤ yet at once, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who finished it that month, he finished it ⑥ yet without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was that the stamp be signed ⑦ yet every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ yet careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done yet.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978 she finished the stamp ⑨ yet without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Yet, she said in 1980, that was the part the office never forgot; the file still speaks yet of it. She kept the stamp in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how yet it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 还（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had yet finished …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 还（修饰形容词：yet ready）
C. adv. 仍然（评注性状语，置于句首：Yet, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 仍然（修饰过去分词：had yet signed it）
E. adv. 还（句末状语：… yet at once）
F. adv. 还（句末状语：… yet without a word of thanks，第 6 处）
G. adv. 仍然（被动结构中的中位状语：be signed yet）
H. adv. 仍然（修饰形容词：be yet careful about the whole business）

items.q: yet without a word of thanks

answers.why: yet 意为“还”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Yet, in 1968 …。
yet 意为“还”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had yet finished the stamp。
yet 意为“还”，此处修饰形容词 ready（准备好）：was yet ready。
yet 意为“仍然”，此处修饰过去分词 signed：had yet signed it twice。
yet 意为“还”，此处置于句末修饰动词：finished the stamp yet at once。
yet 意为“还”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it yet without a word of thanks。
yet 意为“仍然”，被动结构 be signed yet 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
yet 意为“仍然”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be yet careful about the whole business。
yet 意为“还”，1978 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次完成那件小小的印章，副词置于动词之后。
yet 意为“仍然”，母亲 1980 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Yet, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

雨季到来之前，书记员已经还完成那件小小的印章。（had yet finished …）

叔叔还完成那件小小的印章，办事处里没有一个人怀疑。（… yet …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最还。（the yetest of all of them）

Before the May rains the clerk had yet finished the stamp.
